To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the E protein of the HCoV-43 strain of human coronaviruses is critical for infectious virion production and propagation and is a determinant for neurovirulence and central nervous system pathology.
the HCoV-oc43 E protein is critical to the production of infectious virions in vitro and to the neurovirulence of HCoV-43.
the HCoV- OC43 E protein is critical in virus replication and propagation in neuronal cell lines and in murine primary cultures of the central nervous system, and thereby in virus neurovirulence.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the E protein in the pathogenesis of HCoV-43.
the characterization of the HCoV-oc43 E protein in terms of its role in viral morphogenesis and replication in neuronal cells and its implication in neurovirulence.
the role of the E protein in HCoV- OC43 replication and pathogenesis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
HCoV-43 E protein is critical and necessary for HCoV-44 neurovirulence, CNS pathology and efficient virus propagation.
E protein is critical in HCoV-43 infection and propagation in neuronal cell types and that the E protein contributes to the neurovirulent potential of HCoV- OC43.
the E protein plays an important role in the neurotropic capacities of HCoV- OC43.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
HCoV- OC43 E protein is critical in virus production and propagation and in virulence.
the E protein of HCoV- OC43 is a determinant of virus neurovirulence and neurotropism.
the E protein of HCoV-oc43 is critical for virus production and propagation and for virulence in the central nervous system.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the E protein, a small structural component of coronaviruses, is essential for optimal virus replication in neuronal cells and thereby plays a major role in HCoV- OC43 neurotropism and neurovirulence.
the HCoV-oc43 E protein is a major determinant of virus neuroinvasion, neuroinfection and CNS pathology.
the E protein of HCoV-oc43 is critical for virus replication in neuronal cells and for the neurovirulence of the HCoV-43 strain.
